description: Check which conversions switchfile supports. With from: the possible targets of that input format with minimum credits per file and suggested targets. With to: the input formats that can be converted to it. With from and to: whether the pair is supported, its credits and its options (names, allowed values, defaults). Without arguments: only the input formats per group.

from.description: Input format, for example heic or mkv.

to.description: Target format, for example jpg or mp4.

name: list_formats
title: List supported formats
